name: OpenMediaVault
author: Netlens
description: Shows an OpenMediaVault NAS (version 6, 7 or 8) as a host with its Docker containers (from the openmediavault-compose plugin) and its virtual machines (from the openmediavault-kvm plugin) as guests: state, health, image and the ports containers publish, matched to the devices on your network. Also fills the Storage page (Netlens 0.4.180). Read-only, through OMV's web API.

info.title: Set up a user for Netlens on the OpenMediaVault
info.text: OpenMediaVault's web interface API only answers its administrators, so Netlens needs a web administrator account of its own: in the OMV web page open Users > Users > Create, name it netlens with a long random password, and under Groups tick openmediavault-admin (and nothing else). Do not use the 'admin' account, and do not switch on 2-step verification for this user. Enter the address you open OMV with in your browser (http://<NAS address> or https://...); Netlens signs in for a few seconds at each sync and signs out again. The Docker list needs the openmediavault-compose plugin (OMV-Extras) and the virtual machine list the openmediavault-kvm plugin; without them the NAS is shown with what is available. Only the machines and containers are read; nothing is changed.
info.code:
# OMV web page: Users > Users > Create
#   Name: netlens   (a long, random password)
#   Groups: openmediavault-admin
# In Netlens: address http://<NAS address>, user netlens, that password
